senses.gloss: (b. h.;Pilp. of פָּרַר) to crush, crumble, pulverize.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:14">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:14">XIII</cite>), 14 <he>מְפַרְפְּרִין גלוסקין וכ׳</he> you may crumble a piece of fine bread (into milk &c.) for a sick person &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 17b:7">Bets. 17ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:4">Tosef. ib. II, 4</cite> <he>פ׳ ביצה על וכ׳</he> if one crumbles a hard-boiled egg over fish; Y. ib. II, 61ᵇ; a. e.
